seo_title: TappyType EasyFont | Korean Handwriting Font Maker
seo_desc: Create a Korean handwriting font with TappyType (EasyFont) on iPhone and iPad. Write 39 characters; AI fills 2,350 Hangul syllables. Preview free, then unlock TTF export and installation with a one-time purchase.
og_title: TappyType EasyFont — Make a font from your handwriting
og_desc: Start with 39 characters. Create and preview your Korean handwriting font on iPhone and iPad, then export a TTF or install it for use in supported apps.
og_alt: TappyType EasyFont handwriting font maker for iPhone and iPad
hero_sub: Write 39 starter characters with Apple Pencil or your finger in TappyType EasyFont. AI uses your style to fill 2,350 common Hangul syllables. Preview for free, then export a .ttf for apps that support custom fonts.
tt_note: ✍️ This is a real handwriting font made with TappyType — in the app, your writing looks like this.
how_sub: How your handwriting gets recognized and baked into a font — 55 seconds is enough. Here it is, step by step.
step1_p: Get TappyType EasyFont on your iPhone or iPad.
step2_p: Follow the baseline and tracing hints for a few characters. It previews live as you write.
step4_p: A one-time purchase unlocks TTF export and device installation. Writing, previews, and postcards are free.
step3_t: Use your font in other apps
step3_p: Install your font, then select it in apps that support user-installed fonts. This does not change the system-wide iOS font.
moment_sub: AI uses your 39 starter characters to fill common Hangul syllables. Write Latin letters, numbers, and symbols yourself. Results depend on the clarity and shape of your samples.
lw_title: Trace fun sentences, and your font takes shape
lw_sub: Fun K-culture sentences teach you key letters as you write — and every line shows its meaning.
fg_sub: Same sentence, a different hand each time — all real .ttf handwriting fonts.
fg_sample: 오늘 쓴 손글씨가 그대로 폰트가 됐어요
pc_title: Send postcards in your own hand
pc_sub: Your handwritten message over a photo or a soft color. Save to Photos or share it when you love it.
pv2_title: Your finished font, all over daily life
pv2_sub: GoodNotes diaries, Procreate lettering, Keynote, handwritten cards — real examples styled with your own handwriting font.
pv_title: No accounts, no ads, no tracking
pv_li1: Writing, previewing, and exporting font files happen on your device.
pv_li2: Glyph images for AI generation and completed fonts for installation signing are temporarily sent to our server. Their contents are never written to files or logs.
st_title: How my handwriting became a real font
mk_title: Built by two friends who met at nine
mk_jiin: From design to the app to this very site — everything that reaches your hands.
mk_bobae: Computer vision is what got me into ML; 3+ years of production systems later — tabular classifiers, generative AI, LLM pipelines — I still care most about what a model does for the person using it. Here, that's something genuinely fun: teaching a model to read your 손글씨 and turn it into a font that's actually yours.
ig_sub: We document the build and updates on Instagram.

ft_tag: TappyType EasyFont · 이지폰트 — Handwriting fonts for iPhone & iPad
ft_download: Get it on the App Store
brand_description: EasyFont, 이지폰트, and TappyType are names for the same handwriting font app. Create your own Korean font and use it in apps that support custom fonts.
faq_identity_q: Are EasyFont and TappyType different apps?
faq_identity_a: They are the same app. EasyFont is also called 이지폰트 in Korean. Our official website is tappytype.com; use the App Store link below to find the app.
faq_letters_q: Does AI generate Latin letters and numbers?
faq_letters_a: AI fill covers 2,350 common Hangul syllables. To include Latin letters, numbers, and symbols in your handwriting, write those characters yourself.
faq_price_q: Can I try it for free?
faq_price_a: Writing, AI generation, previews, and postcards are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks TTF export and device installation. Check the App Store purchase screen for your local price.
faq_install_q: Will it change the font everywhere on my iPhone?
faq_install_a: It does not replace the system-wide iOS font. Once installed, your font is available in apps that support user-installed fonts.
